title: First-Class Hover and Selection Mechanism
description: Dissolve hover and selection out of per-app commands/config into one first-class framework mechanism: unified InteractionDefinition per domain (granularities, hierarchy provider, HoverSpec, SelectionSpec) declared in the manifest alongside actions/utilities/tools/commands; new 🕹️interaction framework module holding the pure state machine (merge modes, range, transitive closure, validate_state) with Rust+TS parity and schema leaves; persisted-local selection via a new store HistoryLane mechanism that default undo/redo skips; ephemeral hover; uniform presence broadcast of selection/hover for every app via a typed PresenceInteraction field (wire bit 7) on PresencePeer; framework interception of interaction verbs in VcsArtifactApp replacing all per-app set-selection/set-hover handlers; UiTree/Tree/Shell/surface integration; migration of all ~14 apps plus the OS infinite module and fixtures. Plan file: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/hover-and-selection-must-crystalline-stallman.md
summary:
Dissolved hover and selection out of per-app commands/config into one first-class framework mechanism, end to end across the framework and 31 plugin crates plus the OS world surface.

MECHANISM. Declaration lives in the manifest as a sibling of actions/utilities/tools/commands: AppDefinition.interactions (Vec<InteractionDefinition>) and WindowKindDefinition.interactions (Vec<InteractionRef>), each domain declaring granularities, a HierarchyProvider (Flat | Topology | UiTree | PathDelimited{delimiter}), a HoverSpec{enabled,transitive,channels,broadcast} and a SelectionSpec{modes,methods,merges,transitive,broadcast}; AppBuilder.interaction()/.window_kind_interactions() declare and bind them with build-time validation (unique domains, non-empty granularities, transitive requires non-Flat hierarchy, refs resolve). The selection algebra (next_selection/next_hover/validate_state, InteractionState, DomainSelection/DomainHover, topology types, Replace/Additive/Subtractive/Invertive/Range merges) lives once in semio-framework-os-kernel, mirrored handcrafted in TypeScript for the UI. VcsArtifactApp intercepts the six framework-injected verbs (interactionSelect, interactionHover, clearSelection, selectAll, setSelectionMode, setInteractionGranularity) before app dispatch, runs the pure machine, persists, and records under a new ActionKind::Interaction so picks never dirty the history panel. Apps read state through InteractionView on handle/copy_fragment/cut_operations; only Topology domains implement interaction_topology. validate_state runs after every document dispatch so deleted ids fall out of selection with zero app code.

PERSISTENCE. Per the owner's decision, selection/mode/granularity are persisted-local but excluded from default undo/redo via a new general store mechanism: HistoryLane{Document,Interaction} with a sparse lane ledger on ArtifactEnvelope, ApplyInLane/AmendInLane/UndoInLane/RedoInLane, and cursor movement that walks past Interaction entries to the nearest document edit. Hover is never persisted.

PRESENCE. PresencePeer.interaction (typed PresenceInteraction, wire bit 7) is assembled from InteractionState on the existing heartbeat, so every app broadcasts selection and hover with no app code (previously only four apps did it ad hoc); the Shell renders any peer's state generically via derivePeerInteractionByDomain/peerIdsSelecting/peerIdsHovering.

UI. UiTreeNode.interaction_domain binds a rendered tree to a domain and the framework stamps UiPresence{hover,selected} onto its items; UiTreeNode.selected_ids/highlighted_ids/selection_change, UiTreeItemNode.hover_action/unhover_action and ViewModel.selection_json are deleted. Tree delegates to the shared machine (preserving its two deliberately distinct clamps) and one modifier-to-merge policy lives in the React host.

MIGRATION. 31 plugin crates migrated: the 17 the inventory found plus 14 it missed (flow, dag, architect, sequence, animate, forms, vcs, reasoning-mindmap, playbook, imperative, fem, mathematical, norm, playbook-procedural) — the SDK change broke every ArtifactApp implementor, not only those with selection. Bespoke behavior became declarative: writer's jack_ast_node_for_selection covering logic dissolved into transitive on a Topology AST domain; lowpoly's ten config fields collapsed to one declaration; flow's dual-tracked selection (config store plus presence mirror, guaranteed to drift) collapsed to a single source. Retained verbs that operate on the selection (delete/duplicate/focus/zoom/rotate/scale/translate-selection, all nine nudge-selection variants, select-same-kind, set-selected-opacity, select-generation) now read InteractionView. Also removed 11 copy-pasted testkit workarounds by adding the six injected verbs to the framework's own skip list.

KEY DECISIONS. Interaction state lives in a sibling interaction_store rather than folded into A::Config (folding it in required a generic FrameworkConfig<C> wrapper touching dozens of call sites per app). The runtime layer lives in os-kernel and the declaration layer in semio-framework because the reverse crate edge would be a cycle and InteractionDefinition/GranularityDefinition carry LocalizedLabel/IconName; validate_state therefore takes InteractionOutline via InteractionDefinition::outline(). Flat domains are excluded from pruning because an empty topology means "prune everything", not "don't prune". Navigation (the playbook generation picker) is not selection and keeps plain per-item actions. The world surface emits into the domain bound to its window rather than a hardcoded "world" — the hardcoding was a real bug that made CAD's world picks invisible to CAD's own selection state.

VERIFICATION. cargo check --workspace --keep-going clean except semio-compose-rs (another session's os_vcs refactor in compose/client/). semio-framework 105 green; semio-framework-os-kernel 862 green with one pre-existing os_dsl fixture-sweep failure; framework TS 146 vitest green; all 7 new interaction tests in semio-framework-plugin green (lane discipline, ephemeral hover, UiTree stamping, ActionKind recording, transitive-Flat rejection, window binding and action injection).

NOT DONE / OUTSTANDING. Runtime smoke testing was not performed — the dev-preview scenarios (two-peer presence, transitive hover on a group, undo skipping a pick, marquee granularity switching) have not been exercised in a running app. dispatch_emit_group (composite/child-artifact dispatch) does not yet run post-dispatch revalidation. PathDelimited topology self-derivation only knows ids seen by current and prior dispatches. block-3D's world window and puzzle-3D/5D were left with unbound world domains on purpose because they already emit their own interaction verbs and binding risked double-emission. semio-framework-os-infinite's lib tests cannot compile because another session's in-flight change removed Index from DslValue (cargo check was the gate). One failing test in semio-framework-plugin (view_action_emitting_ops_is_rejected) is attributable to a concurrent session's actions-into-commands merge, not to this work: the guard is intact but registry.get_command no longer resolves view actions mid-merge; this crate was verified 165/0 before their 12:44 commit. Full detail in the ticket's closing-summary.md, residue-sweep.md and build-audit.md.
